title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline
tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A polished 16:9 thumbnail pairs a large, visibly tired face with the bold, easily readable headline “STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT,” with no evident problems.

must_haves.item: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
must_haves.why: The 16:9 image features a large face with heavy eyelids and a weary expression, lying on a pillow beside a phone.

must_haves.item: A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
must_haves.why: The completed headline reads “STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT,” exactly three words.

must_haves.item: The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
must_haves.why: The headline directly calls for stopping scrolling tonight, reinforced by the nighttime bedroom setting.

must_haves.item: The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
must_haves.why: Very large yellow and white lettering stands out clearly against the dark background.

must_haves.item: The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.
must_haves.why: The facial features are clearly visible, and all headline letters fit fully inside the image with adequate margins.
